title: Chapter 836
text:
Everyone sat down and started the meeting. Tarrokov's meeting was to explain the current situation of the exploration.

After listening for a while, Ravenlaude was in a good mood. He was also exploring the Garu Star Cluster, and the long-distance stargate built by the Black Star Corps gave him more options, which was very beneficial to him.

"I wonder what Black Star is thinking." Ravenlaude chuckled.

Heber explored the Renault Star Cluster slowly and steadily, and the subsequent exploration teams would not be able to gain anything, so they could only take their time. However, the Black Star Corps did not seem to care about their own interests, burning themselves to warm the future generations. What kind of spirit was this? This was the spirit of selflessness!

Glancing at Han Xiao, Ravenlaude's eyes became more and more playful.

Noticing Ravenlaude's gaze, Han Xiao turned around and smiled at him with mockery in his eyes.

Although the long-distance stargate made Ravenlaude's exploration more convenient, the biggest reward, the Spacetime Amber, was already in his hands.

Furthermore, even if Ravenlaude could use the long-distance stargate to explore many areas freely, the richest and most famous planets in his previous life were all taken by Han Xiao, and there were very few good planets left for Ravenlaude. Of course, Ravenlaude knew nothing about this.

When their eyes met, it was as if sparks were flying. It was as if they were having a silent exchange. There was a deep meaning hidden in their eyes. It could be roughly described as follows:

Ravenlaude thought, Humph, you're at a disadvantage.

Han Xiao thought, Tsk tsk, you still don't know that you're the one at a disadvantage.

…

The meeting ended very quickly, and everyone left. As the first batch of exploration teams, including Han Xiao and Heber, had already built the stargate and bridgehead, the second batch of exploration teams could directly reach the various Star Clusters and did not need to waste time on Planet Lighthouse.

Milizaus and Beyoni's troops also moved out, but they stayed behind to accompany Han Xiao, acting as temporary guards for the Evolution Cube.

As Beyond Grade A combatants of the dynasty, neither of them minded bonding with their colleague, Black Star.

The three of them sat across from each other in the spacious room. Three cups of hot, red-hot liquid were placed on the table. This was a specialty that Beyoni had brought from his home. It was said to be a special drink that the Flame Demons loved.

Han Xiao took a big gulp. It tasted sticky and hot, like a line of fire going down his throat. His stomach felt warm, and a series of "− 0", "− 0" damage notifications popped up above his head.

"The texture is not bad. What is this?" Han Xiao smacked his lips. It felt good.

"Hehe, this is magma from the Land of the Fire Core. It's also mixed with concentrated alcohol. It tastes good, right?"

Motherf * cker, you actually gave me lava to drink … Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

The Land of the Fire Core. This seemed to be the only Universal Treasure that the Fire Demon Race possessed. It seemed to be a hotbed that could allow young Fire Demons to grow quickly. Han Xiao remembered that the Extinguish Army had always wanted to destroy this thing.

After hesitating for a while, Han Xiao still did not put down the cup. He could not help but take another sip and lick his lips.

"… Another cup."

Needless to say, the taste was a little addictive.

He had even stayed on a Star before. Drinking some magma was just a basic operation.

Milizaus looked at the cup in front of him speechlessly. He did not know whether he should drink or not. Shaking his head, he interrupted the two of them and asked, "Black Star, what's the deal you mentioned earlier?"

Han Xiao put down the cup, smiled, and said, "The various kinds of Dragon Blood Potions of the Dragonblood Nation are famous in the universe. I want to use the slots of the Evolution Cube to exchange for Dragon Blood Potions. You're the leader of the Astral Spiritual Dragon Race, so I'm sure you want to let some of your capable people evolve, right?"

Milizaus pondered for a while before nodding. "Sure. How do you want to exchange?"

The Dragon Blood Potion was a special product that was sold, so Milizaus naturally would not reject it. The Dragonblood Nation was made up of mixed-blood dragons that were watered with Dragon Blood. They were considered a vassal and armed organization of the race. The Astral Spiritual Dragon Race was the foundation that he valued.

"Two tons of ordinary Dragon Blood Potion and one hundred kilograms of refined Dragon Blood Potion in exchange for one hundred slots of the Evolution Cube."

Milizaus was a little confused.

Tons?

Dragon Blood Potion is usually sold by the bottle, you b * stard!

Milizaus' tone was dissatisfied. "More than ten tons of Grade C Dragon Blood can only be refined into one ton of Dragon Blood Potion. The ratio of refined Dragon Blood Potion is even worse. Why don't I just give you a few dragons and you bleed yourself?"

Han Xiao pondered seriously. "That's not impossible …"

"You're too greedy!" Milizaus said angrily.

"It's not like I'm going to buy all the slots at once. It's fine to take it slow." Han Xiao chuckled. Friendship was friendship, but when it came to business, he still had to be greedy.

He wanted so much Dragon Blood Potion, and of course, he would not be able to use it all. He would mainly use it to train capable officers and sell it to the players at a high price.

Through selling the specialties of the other faction, he would expand the product channels of the Black Star Corps and increase the attractiveness of the faction. This had already become Han Xiao's habit.

Milizaus was speechless. Although we're big and have a lot of blood, you can't just squeeze all the juice out of us!

"If you have any concerns, I can let your people experience the actual effect of the Evolution Cube once for free," Han Xiao said.

"Alright, let's find an empty space. I'll call a dragon down." Milizaus nodded.

Han Xiao looked at Beyoni, and Beyoni did not have any objections. He also wanted to observe the effect.

The three of them went out together and came to a spacious metal square.

Han Xiao looked up and saw a giant dragon descending from the sky.

Whoosh!

The dragon flapped its wings, stirring up a whistling gale. The astral spirit dragon landed on the square with a bang, causing the ground to tremble slightly.

Han Xiao sized it up. This giant dragon was about a thousand meters tall, with two pairs of wide dragon wings on its back and three pairs of dragon claws below its body. Its neck was raised high like a thick python, and its head was lowered. A pair of cold golden dragon eyes stared at the three of them.

This was a normal Astral Spirit Dragon. Compared to Milizaus, its size was not as exaggerated. Furthermore, this Astral Spirit Dragon did not have the habit of running around naked. Its body was covered in sections of black metal armor. Most of its body was wrapped in specially made heavy armor.

The armor was also equipped with mechanical weapons, including battleship turrets, battleship shields, and so on. It could be said that it was fully armed. Such a heavily-armed giant dragon could be used as a battleship. The machinery and flesh created a sense of beauty.

On this armor and dragon body, there were a large number of magic circuits, shining with a faint light. Clearly, they were enchanted.

"These are my Armed Dragon Guards. Let them try the effect of the Evolution Cube first," Milizaus said. As a Beyond Grade A, he also had his own elite troops. The Armed Dragon Guards were similar to Austin's Forbidden Sorcerers.

Woah, this guy looks really cool … Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. The image of such a giant being fully armed was really to his liking.

After temporarily removing the seal on the Evolution Cube, Han Xiao activated it. Black evolution energy surged out and wrapped around this Armed Dragon Guard, forming an evolution black cocoon.

Crack!

Not long after, the black cocoon shattered like a newborn breaking out of an egg. In the sharp senses of the three Beyond Grade As, the aura of this Armed Dragon Guard had become much stronger. Its body had obviously become larger, and the heavy armor on its body did not fit well anymore.

Roar!

The Armed Dragon Guard abruptly spat out a mouthful of dazzling silver-purple dragon breath into the sky. The surging light pillar was like a fountain that soared into the sky, continuously spreading out like a brilliant sea of light. Fragments of light that looked like broken jade exploded thousands of meters high in the air like fireworks. The momentum was astonishing.

"Looks like the effect is not bad." Beyoni was a little jealous. If the females of the Balrog Race were strengthened, they would be able to withstand more of his scorching essence. It would definitely be beneficial for the reproduction of his race.

Milizaus was also very satisfied with what he had paid for.

"Alright, this price it is. I'll buy … two thousand slots first."

"How can two thousand be enough? Although your Astral Spiritual Dragon Race has a small population, there are at least a million dragons, right? Buy more." Han Xiao chuckled.

"We'll talk about that later." Milizaus snorted.

If you buy tens of thousands of slots at once, our Astral Spiritual Dragon Race can change its name to Anemic Dragon Race.

"I have one more request." Han Xiao laughed dryly and sized up the Armed Dragon Guard in front of him. "I feel that your Astral Spiritual Dragon Race is quite beautiful …"

"What do you want now?" Milizaus was vigilant.

"Do you mind if I recruit a few Astral Spiritual Dragons as partners?"

"Don't even think about it!" Milizaus was so angry that he almost could not maintain his Magic Incarnation.

Partners? Do you think I didn't see that lustful look in your eyes? You probably want my people to be your mounts, right? This is too much. Why don't you just ride me!

Milizaus had already read Han Xiao's information before coming, so he had some understanding of how thick Han Xiao's skin was. However, after interacting with him, the thickness of Han Xiao's skin still exceeded his expectations. Not only did he brazenly raise the price, but he even said that he wanted to ride his dragon descendants right in front of him. There was actually such a shameless Beyond Grade A!

However, Milizaus was not disgusted. Instead, he liked Black Star's way of doing things. More than eighty percent of the Beyond Grade As in the universe were concerned about being cool, and he always had a cold face, afraid that others would not know that he was a big shot. Occasionally, he would meet someone with a different style, and he would be quite happy.

After living for so long, one would either not care about anything or become more interested in new things. Milizaus and Aesop had a lot in common — they were both masochists.

…

Central Galaxy, Bright Silver Cantilever, Arcane Church's mother planet.

In a huge hall, the Bishops sat around a round table, discussing the issue of the Evolution Cube.

Dispatching a large number of Beyond Grade A combatants at once was not a small matter, and it required the highest level of the Arcane Church to make a decision. Due to Sisko's incident, the Bishops had different opinions.

"I think we should give up on this plan!"

As he spoke, a bishop stood up and said with a calm tone, "We've lost our connection to the Evolution Cube and are now in a dilemma. According to the latest intelligence, the dynasty has noticed our intentions, and Black Star has returned to the outpost on Planet Lighthouse, hiding under heavy protection. The dynasty has also assigned two bodyguards to him, 'Incinerate' Beyoni and 'Dragon King' Milizaus. If we continue with our plan, we will be facing three high-level combatants of the Crimson Dynasty, which is already in the category of a head-on conflict, going against our original intentions.

This will be our original intention. "" The security around Planet Lighthouse is tight. As long as our stowaway fleet appears in the surveillance sector of Planet Lighthouse, we will be discovered by the dynasty. At that time, we will be facing the garrison of Planet Lighthouse who has completed their war preparations. The risk is too high. "

Everyone looked at him and remained silent.

"More importantly, we have lost the location of the Evolution Cube. If Black Star hides it, we will not be able to find it. Capturing Black Star alive is also an extremely difficult mission. The reward is not proportional to the risk. We …" After pausing for a while, this Bishop sighed. "Let's give up on the Evolution Cube."

Everyone could not refute and subconsciously turned to look at the main seat. It should have been the Pope's seat, but it was currently empty. However, everyone knew that the discussion had reached the ears of the Pope.

The discussion had reached a stalemate, and the rest was up to the Pope.

After waiting for a while, a 3D projection suddenly appeared in the middle of the round table, and a few lines of words appeared. This was the Pope's reply, and the Bishops all looked over.

The Pope's reply had a total of four messages.

"First, God has revealed that the Evolution Cube is still with Black Star.

"Second, the plan has been changed. We will attack Planet Lighthouse.

"Third, we have a new target. We are allowed to use the [Ten Thousand Deity Scepter] to try and kill Milizaus.

"Fourth, the Radiant Federation has agreed to provide assistance.
